British customers fall under a UK Gambling Commission licence specifically, with a separate Gibraltar Gambling Commission authorisation covering the rest of the operator's reach.

Responsible gambling tools are a must and customers are verified before cashing out. Add in the decade-plus history behind the wider Grace Media operation and the regulatory picture here looks solid.

Football and tennis handle the bulk of everyday betting, with golf and American sports also covered, though horse racing fans will find less on offer here than at a dedicated racing site.
